page_title: SAS 1-1 UDI | Sassuolo v Udinese 01/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's it for today, Michael Fabbri has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+3' Sassuolo take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+1' Substitution. Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Armand Lauriente walks off.

90+1' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
90' Gabriele Cioffi has decided to substitute Florian Thauvin and he is replaced by Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese).
89' The manager makes a subsitution with Isaac Success (Udinese) coming on for Lorenzo Lucca.

87' Samu Castillejo (Sassuolo) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
86' A clumsy foul by Hassane Kamara (Udinese) and Michael Fabbri blows his whistle. Sassuolo earn a free kick.
86' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
84' Udinese are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
79' Davide Ballardini has decided to make a change. Samu Castillejo (Sassuolo) replaces Matheus Henrique.
79' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo) is coming onto the pitch as Gregoire Defrel cannot continue after picking up an injury.
79' Sassuolo take a short corner kick.
78' Daniel Boloca (Sassuolo) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball. Sassuolo win a corner.
77' Gabriele Cioffi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Oier Zarraga (Udinese) replacing Sandi Lovric.
72' It's time for a substitution. Daniel Boloca (Sassuolo) comes on in place of Uros Racic.
71' A cross from a corner kick by Sassuolo is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
70' Josh Doig (Sassuolo) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention. Sassuolo have been awarded a corner kick.
70' The game is interrupted as Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) is flagged offside.
65' The corner is swung in but Sassuolo can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

64' Uros Racic (Sassuolo) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of a cross inside the box. He attempted to strike with a header to the left post, but it missed accuracy and the keeper made an easy save.
64' Sassuolo quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
60' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) swings in a cross from the corner, but Andrea Consigli reads it well and gathers the ball.
58' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
53' Matheus Henrique (Sassuolo) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
52' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out for a corner. Sassuolo can continue in their attacking effort.
50' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
50' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort just wide of the left post.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.

45+1' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' 1 - 1 Florian Thauvin (Udinese) received a delightful pass inside the box before slotting the ball past the goalkeeper. What a brilliant finish!
43' Matheus Henrique (Sassuolo) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

41' 1 - 0 A superb goal from great team play! Gregoire Defrel (Sassuolo) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent low shot inside the left post. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
40' Josh Doig (Sassuolo) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
38' A corner kick by Sassuolo is thwarted by the well prepared Maduka Okoye (Udinese).
38' The ball is cleared after Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Sassuolo.
36' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires high and wide.
34' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) makes a good run into the box to meet a cross and fires the ball in on goal, but the shot is amazingly blocked by a defender.
32' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) has an effort on goal, but he misses to the right of the goal.
28' Hassane Kamara beats an opponent and whips a cross into the box towards Florian Thauvin (Udinese), who smashes a first-time shot high over the bar.
28' Michael Fabbri has a clear sight and sees a foul from Josh Doig (Sassuolo).
26' Uros Racic (Sassuolo) takes a long run up and launches the free kick towards goal from the edge of the box, but the defensive wall bravely blocks the effort.
25' Jaka Bijol (Udinese) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
25' A quickly taken corner by Sassuolo.

25' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort. The ball goes out of play. Sassuolo are awarded a corner kick.
22' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls it and sends it straight at Andrea Consigli, who makes a comfortable save.
20' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
19' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Michael Fabbri has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
16' The foul by Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Michael Fabbri.
13' The corner from Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) is intercepted by the defence.
10' A rebound falls to Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) in space inside the box. He looks up and fires in a powerful shot at goal that flies just wide of the right post.
10' Maduka Okoye pulls off a great save to deny Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom right corner.
9' The Udinese players are exchanging some short passes.
5' The free kick into the box finds Gian Marco Ferrari (Sassuolo), who directs his header into the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off a fantastic reflex save. Great goalkeeping.
4' Joao Ferreira (Udinese) brings his opponent down. Michael Fabbri has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Sassuolo will take a free kick near the side line.
3' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
2' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) is caught offside!
1' The match has just started.
Sassuolo will kick the game off.
